The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a [[church]] workstation that provides a passive +1{{Church Rating}} Church Quality, which can be temporarily supplemented by applying one of three available consumables - candles.
Candelabras can be deconstructed again by using the remove option on the [[Blueprints#Church|church blueprint]], for making space for upgraded versions of the candelabra or other church furnishing.
